title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Dai, a shipwrecked boy raised by the kindly monster Brass on an island where freed monsters live in peace, dreams of being a hero. When the demon lord Hadlar returns, Dai's teacher Avan sacrifices himself to protect his students, and Dai and fellow student Pop set out to restore peace. A long Shonen Jump adventure set in the Dragon Quest video-game world.
life_message: Courage, training and loyalty to friends and teachers can overcome evil, and former enemies can become allies.
